{"source":"import Base

# A finite three-point stencil, extended by zero at both ends.
def Life.stencil(
  ~A: Data, ~B: Data, ~f: A -> A -> A -> B,
  xs: List<&2, A>, left: A, +zero: A
) -> List<&2, B>:
  match xs:
    case Nil{}:
      Nil{}
    case Con{+center, +rest}:
      right = Maybe.default(&2, A, List.head(&2, A, rest), zero)
      f(left, center, right)
        <> Life.stencil(~A, ~B, ~f, rest, center, zero)

# Each column stores twice its population, with its center in the low bit.
def Life.columns(
  middle: List<&2, U32>, above: List<&2, U32>, below: List<&2, U32>
) -> List<&2, U32>:
  match middle:
    case Nil{}:
      Nil{}
    case Con{+alive, rest}:
      +upper = above
      +lower = below
      top = Maybe.default(&2, U32, List.head(&2, U32, upper), 0)
      bottom = Maybe.default(&2, U32, List.head(&2, U32, lower), 0)
      population = (top + alive + bottom : U32)
      (2 * population + alive : U32)
        <> Life.columns(rest, List.tail(&2, U32, upper),
          List.tail(&2, U32, lower))

# OR with a binary center merges counts two and three only for living cells.
def Life.resolve(left: U32, center: U32, right: U32) -> U32:
  +packed = center
  +alive = U32.and(packed, 1)
  population = (U32.shr(left) + U32.shr(packed) + U32.shr(right) : U32)
  neighbors = (population - alive : U32)
  Bool.to_u32(U32.is_eq(U32.or(neighbors, alive), 3))

def Life.row(
  above: List<&2, U32>, middle: List<&2, U32>, below: List<&2, U32>
) -> List<&2, U32>:
  Life.stencil(~U32, ~U32, ~Life.resolve,
    Life.columns(middle, above, below), 0, 0)

def Life.split(
  height: Nat, +width: Nat, +cells: List<&2, U32>
) -> List<&2, List<&2, U32>>:
  match height:
    case 0n:
      Nil{}
    case 1n+rest:
      List.take(&2, U32, cells, width)
        <> Life.split(rest, width, List.drop(&2, U32, cells, width))

def step(width: U32, height: U32, cells: List<&2, U32>) -> List<&2, U32>:
  rows = Life.split(U32.to_nat(height), U32.to_nat(width), cells)
  List.concat(&2, U32,
    Life.stencil(~List<&2, U32>, ~List<&2, U32>, ~Life.row,
      rows, Nil{}, Nil{}))

def evolve(
  turns: Nat, +width: U32, +height: U32, cells: List<&2, U32>
) -> List<&2, U32>:
  match turns:
    case 0n:
      cells
    case 1n+rest:
      evolve(rest, width, height, step(width, height, cells))
","hypothesis":"Preserve the shared zero-extended stencil suggested by the stimulus's repeated neighborhoods, but compress the transition rule into (neighbors OR alive)==3. For a dead center this accepts exactly three neighbors; for a living center it accepts exactly two or three. Subtracting the retained center bit from the inclusive population exposes this relationship directly and replaces two comparisons plus Boolean composition with one bitwise operation and one comparison. Boundary handling, traversal, synchronous updates and structural termination remain unchanged.","findings":"The repaired round-2 implementation passed all supplied behavior gates and had no semantic findings.
